concerns.text: T012 is tagged [P] and listed as 'after T003; parallel to T006+', but it 'runs the full pipeline end-to-end' measuring wall-clock/RAM/disk of the complete workflow — which includes the feature engineering (T004), VIF (T005), training (T006), evaluation (T007–T009), visualization (T010) and report (T011) artifacts that do not exist until those tasks complete. This is a consumer-before-producer dependency and an unsafe [P] tag: T012 must be sequenced after T011 (or explicitly scoped to the Phase-1 pipeline only). The stated execution order '{T012, T013}' after T011 contradicts the dependency note 'after T003; parallel to T006+'.
